title: Foundry, Hosted Agents and Agent 365
tagline: Give the agent a home, an identity and a paper trail.
story: The agent works on a laptop, but it has nowhere to live and nobody knows who it is. Runtime, protocol, tool path and identity choices decide what it can reach and who answers for it. Preview labels and retirement dates move fast, so every product claim here carries the date it was checked.
oneLiner: Choose a runtime, open the right doors, wire tools and knowledge, give the agent an identity and put it under a control plane.
youWillLearn: Compare prompt agents, hosted agents, direct Responses calls, self-hosting and Copilot Studio by control, state and location
Explain hosted agent sessions, sandboxes, versions, scaling and what the 2026-08-20 backend retirement changed
Pick between the Responses, Invocations, Invocations WebSocket, Activity and A2A protocols
Route tools through a Toolbox and choose between Foundry IQ, file search, memory and custom retrieval
Describe Entra Agent ID objects and choose between S2S, OBO and Agentic-User modes
Explain what Agent 365 observes, governs and secures, and how an agent joins it
Label every feature as GA, preview or retiring with the date you checked

flashcards.front: What are the three Foundry Agent Service agent types?
flashcards.back: Prompt agents (configuration, no code), voice-based prompt agents (Voice Live over WebSocket, preview) and hosted agents (your container or .zip). A direct Responses call gives an ephemeral agent.

flashcards.front: What is an **ephemeral agent** in Foundry?
flashcards.back: An agent whose definition lives in your code and runs through direct Responses API calls. No Foundry agent resource exists, so Foundry versions and publishes nothing.

flashcards.front: Hosted agent session states and default idle timeout?
flashcards.back: Active, Idle and Resumed. The idle timeout is set per agent version from 2 to 60 minutes, default 15. State in `$HOME` and `/files` is persisted on idle and restored on resume.

flashcards.front: When is a hosted agent session permanently deleted?
flashcards.back: After 30 days of inactivity. Anything that must outlive that window belongs in storage you own.

flashcards.front: Which sandbox sizes do hosted agents offer?
flashcards.back: 0.5 vCPU with 1 GiB, 1 vCPU with 2 GiB and 2 vCPU with 4 GiB. Docs advise the next size when sustained peaks pass about 70 percent of allocation.

flashcards.front: Can a hosted agent endpoint split traffic between versions?
flashcards.back: No. An endpoint serves one immutable version with 100 percent of traffic. A canary needs a second agent or client-side routing (inference).

flashcards.front: Which protocols can a hosted agent expose?
flashcards.back: Responses, Invocations, Invocations WebSocket, Activity and A2A. One agent can expose several. Activity is bridged from Responses when you publish to Teams or Microsoft 365.

flashcards.front: Responses or Invocations: who owns the conversation history?
flashcards.back: Responses: the platform keeps history and any OpenAI-compatible SDK is the client. Invocations: you manage sessions and write raw SSE.

flashcards.front: What is a Foundry **Toolbox**?
flashcards.back: A group of tools behind one managed MCP-compatible endpoint, with central auth, toolbox-level guardrails and versioning. Promote a version to default and consumers pick it up with no redeploy.

flashcards.front: What do `tool_search` and `call_tool` do?
flashcards.back: They are the two meta-tools exposed when tool search is on (preview). Tools stay hidden by default, so a toolbox can hold hundreds without flooding context.

flashcards.front: What replaced Connected Agents in the new Foundry Agent Service?
flashcards.back: The A2A tool, which accepts any A2A endpoint, or Workflows (preview, retire 2026-12-01). Docs point new development at Microsoft Agent Framework.

flashcards.front: Foundry IQ retrieval reasoning effort levels?
flashcards.back: Minimal, low or medium. A knowledge base runs on Azure AI Search agentic retrieval, can sync ACLs, honors Purview labels and can run under the caller's Entra identity.

flashcards.front: Name the Entra Agent ID objects.
flashcards.back: Agent identity blueprint (a template that holds credentials, one-to-many), agent identity (no credentials of its own) and an optional agent user account (Frontier preview).

flashcards.front: Sponsor versus owner: who can re-enable a disabled agent?
flashcards.back: Owners can, and can also hard-delete. Sponsors (at least one required, business accountable) can disable or soft-delete but cannot edit auth settings or re-enable.

flashcards.front: S2S, OBO, Agentic-User: who is the token subject?
flashcards.back: S2S: the agent identity. OBO: the user, with the agent identity as actor. Agentic-User: the agent's own user account, which needs the Frontier preview program.

flashcards.front: Why can a correct RBAC assignment still return 403?
flashcards.back: A wrong token audience. Use the downstream resource id such as `https://storage.azure.com`, not the MCP server URL.

flashcards.front: Agent 365: pillars and GA date?
flashcards.back: Observe, govern and secure. GA on 2026-05-01 for the Commercial segment, licensed per user.

flashcards.front: What does the Agent 365 SDK not do?
flashcards.back: It does not build, host, orchestrate or run tools. It adds identity, governed tooling (Work IQ MCP servers) and notifications. You still host the agent.

flashcards.front: What replaced the Agent 365 Observability SDK?
flashcards.back: The Microsoft OpenTelemetry Distro for .NET, Node.js and Python. It also targets Foundry, Azure Monitor and any OTLP backend. The old SDK is deprecated for new work.

flashcards.front: Four guardrail intervention points for Foundry agents?
flashcards.back: User input, tool call (preview), tool response (preview) and output. Agent guardrails are preview, model guardrails are GA. Spotlighting and groundedness do not apply to agents.

glossary.def: A Foundry agent defined as instructions, a model and tools. No code and no container.
A Foundry agent that runs your code as a container image or .zip inside a per-session, VM-isolated sandbox with its own Entra agent identity.
An agent defined in your code and called through the Responses API. No Foundry agent resource exists.
The unit that owns compute and state. It moves between Active, Idle and Resumed, persists `$HOME` and `/files`, and is deleted after 30 days of inactivity.
A versioned group of tools behind one managed MCP-compatible endpoint with central auth and guardrails.
A knowledge base layer on Azure AI Search agentic retrieval that can sync ACLs and honor Purview labels.
The Entra object that holds credentials and creates agent identities. It is a credential boundary.
A service principal of type `ServiceIdentity` that has no credentials. Its blueprint requests tokens for it.
An optional user object marked as an AI agent, 1:1 with an agent identity, with a mailbox and Teams presence. Frontier preview.
The required business owner of an agent object. A sponsor can disable or soft-delete it but cannot edit auth settings or re-enable it.
On-behalf-of. The user is the token subject and the agent identity is the actor, so permissions are delegated.
The Microsoft 365 control plane to observe, govern and secure agents. GA on 2026-05-01. Its registry inventories agents in the admin center.

claims.text: Foundry Agent Service has three agent types: prompt agents, voice-based prompt agents and hosted agents.
Hosted agents run your code as a container image or as a .zip that Foundry builds into an image.
Portal publishing is not supported for projects with public network access disabled. Use the REST API with enable_m365_public_endpoint.
A hosted agent idle timeout is set per agent version from 2 to 60 minutes, default 15.
A hosted agent session is permanently deleted after 30 days of inactivity.
Hosted agent sandbox sizes are 0.5 vCPU 1 GiB, 1 vCPU 2 GiB and 2 vCPU 4 GiB.
A hosted agent endpoint serves one version with 100 percent of traffic and traffic splitting is not supported.
Support for the initial-preview hosted agent backend ended on 2026-08-20, and migration needs azure-ai-projects 2.3.0 or later and azd 1.23.0 or later.
Hosted agent protocols are Responses, Invocations, Invocations WebSocket, Activity and A2A, and one agent can expose several.
On hosted agents A2A v1.0 is GA and A2A v0.3 is preview.
Publishing to Teams or Microsoft 365 creates an Azure Bot Service resource, with Individual scope needing no admin approval and Organization scope needing admin approval.
A Foundry Toolbox groups tools behind one managed MCP-compatible endpoint with central auth, toolbox-level guardrails and versioning.
Tool search (preview) exposes two meta-tools, tool_search and call_tool.
The classic Connected Agents tool is not available in the new Foundry Agent Service. The A2A tool or Workflows replace it.
Foundry Workflows (preview) retire on 2026-12-01 and classic agents retire on 2027-03-31.
Foundry IQ retrieval reasoning effort is minimal, low or medium.
An Entra agent identity is a service principal with servicePrincipalType ServiceIdentity and has no credentials. The blueprint holds the credentials.
Every blueprint and agent identity needs at least one sponsor. Owners are optional technical admins who can re-enable or hard-delete.
In OBO the user is the token subject and the agent identity is the actor. In S2S the agent identity is the subject.
Agent user accounts are available only to tenants in the Frontier preview program.
A token audience set to the MCP server URL instead of the downstream resource id fails even with correct RBAC.
Agent 365 became generally available on 2026-05-01 for the Commercial segment and is licensed per user.
The Agent 365 SDK does not build, host, orchestrate or run tools.
The Agent 365 Observability SDK is deprecated for new work. Use the Microsoft OpenTelemetry Distro.
The Agent 365 registry has four types: Microsoft agents, external partner-built agents, published by your org and shared by creator.
Foundry guardrails have four intervention points: user input, tool call, tool response and output. Agent guardrails are preview.
At the 2026-05-01 GA announcement, agents in team workflows with their own access were public preview.
Agent 365 is the unified agent registry and control plane, while Microsoft Entra provides the identity foundation through Agent ID.
